Memorable Dining
Sep 2026 • Solo
I had the best meal of my trip in SaPa at Yummy Restaurant. The rustic bamboo design and open-air setting created a relaxing atmosphere, with breathtaking views of the mountains, forests, and terraced fields. The staff were friendly, attentive, and spoke English well, making the dining experience even more enjoyable.

The food was outstanding. I especially loved the Stir-Fried Morning Glory with garlic, which was fresh and flavorful, and the Grilled Pork Wrapped in Betel Leaves was absolutely delicious. Huge portions perfect for sharing. With its beautiful scenery, excellent service, and authentic local dishes, Yummy Restaurant is a place I would highly recommend to anyone visiting SaPa.
